title: Chapter 33 Identity Authentication Spores
content:
Chapter 33 Identity Authentication Spores

Early the next morning, most of the refugees outside the city were fast asleep. They were tired, sleepy, and insomniac yesterday, and now they needed to catch up on their sleep.

In the city, the residents have all gotten up. They have become accustomed to the noise outside the city and can now sleep peacefully.

Today, everyone received a new task and went to the Lord's Castle to register their identities.

This registration is different from the registration at the recruitment center, but an identity registration that every resident needs to do.

To put it simply, if you register, you are an official resident of Daxia Territory. If you don’t register, you are not. You are just like the refugees outside the city.

Now that there are so many refugees and so many aboriginal people in Daxia, it will be difficult to manage them when they are mixed together.

Moreover, the refugees must also be managed separately. Those who join the Daxia collar and those who do not join the Daxia collar must not be treated equally.

With this demand in mind, Wu Qing started another research with the Insect Queen.

Wu Qing put forward the requirements and provided ideas and ideas to solve the problem, and the insect queen was responsible for using Zerg technology to realize it.

This division of labor is very efficient. The design plan was finalized last night and the finished product was produced.

This thing is the identity authentication spore.

The technologies of the Zerg are all biotechnologies. Things like spores, which are so subtle that they are invisible and undetectable, and yet controllable by the Zerg, are very suitable for identity authentication of the citizens of the Great Xia Territory.

Wu Qing asked the Queen of Insects to make the memory of the identity authentication spores into a beautiful hand-held ball for swearing. You can place your hand on the ball to take the oath.

As long as someone comes into contact with the ball, the queen can control the release of a unique spore into the person's body.

The spores lurk in the human body and correspond one-to-one with the identity information recorded on the queen. When identity verification is needed, the Zerg can read the person's identity information by identifying the characteristics of the spores.

This is an information management system that makes use of biotechnology. With the support of Zerg, it is very convenient to use.

Moreover, this spore can also be upgraded to cope with changing needs in the future.

Early in the morning, a batch of identity authentication spore memories were delivered from the Zerg territory.

The residents in the city learned that identity authentication was related to the determination of the identity of the subjects, so they quickly dragged their families and lined up in front of the lord's castle.

The identity authentication spore memories were laid out one after another, and the 20 recruited people were still in charge of the identity authentication work. The Queen of Insects personally guided it, while Wu Qing watched through the host.

"Put your hands up and follow me!"

"I swear to the lord! I voluntarily join the Daxia Territory and will never betray you!"

"I promise! All the information provided below is true and valid! If there is any falsehood, I am willing to take full responsibility!"

This opening was added temporarily by Wu Qing. It would appear more solemn and formal, and it might have some unexpected effects.

After the opening remarks, the next step is to register the basic personal information orally. The reason for dictation is that most of the people are illiterate.

As for the possible inaccuracies in the oral registration, it doesn't matter. Everything will be subject to the Queen's records.

Once the basic personal information is dictated and the identity authentication spores enter the human body silently, the entire authentication process is completed.

For those children who cannot tell clearly, adults can help tell the story. Children only need to touch the memory of the identity authentication spores with their hands.

It will take some time to verify the identity of everyone in the city.

Those who complete the certification first can start their day's work.

Today, everyone’s job is basically to collect food in the wild.

For the refugees outside the city, Wu Qing will not let them work until their identities are authenticated.

Refugees need to take a good rest and relax.

The construction of Daxia Territory is not in a hurry at this moment.

When the refugees heard the commotion and saw the residents in the city, led by the Zerg army, heading straight to the wilds and calmly collecting all kinds of food, they realized where the food they ate last night came from.

"I just said that what I ate last night was not common. It turned out that it was all collected in the wild."

"The lord of Daxia Territory is such a kind lord. He actually uses so many troops to protect the people in the territory to collect food in the wild!"

"You know, even if you lose a little bit of the army, the gain outweighs the gain."

"I've thought about it! Although the conditions here are limited, I decided to join the Great Xia Territory! I won't go anywhere else!"

"I also want to join the Great Xia Territory! The kind and powerful lord is our hope!"

"Everyone join in!"

"..."

Wu Qing heard these discussions through the Zerg not far away.

He didn't expect that using these Zerg troops, who had nothing to do without fighting, to do something, they would receive such a high evaluation, which directly increased the attractiveness of the territory.

But think about it, in this world with frequent wars, the lord's army is extremely precious. It needs to be trained at all times to maintain combat effectiveness, and there are many daily tasks.

There is simply no time to care about the life and death of ordinary civilians. If there is no profit, the lord will definitely not send troops.

People like Wu Qing, who took the initiative to send troops to intercept the enemy, risked the loss of troops to protect the refugees, and usually sent troops to protect the people when they went out to work, were really unreasonable in the eyes of ordinary people.

What is the point of doing this?

Wu Qing was really seeking profit, and he was also seeking fame.

"This feels good!"

"Whether you think I'm kind or stupid, this will be my label in this world from now on!"

"A kind fool lord!"

Wu Qing was quite satisfied with this label of his.

...

The sun rose high, and the identity authentication of the residents in the city had been completed. They received work tasks, and many people's work was to prepare breakfast for the refugees outside the city.

After a simple breakfast, Hu Tu took 20 recruiters and moved the temporary recruitment hall's furniture outside the city.

The Queen of Insects issued a notice to all refugees through the host.

"Please go to the identity authentication office to register your identity."

"For the convenience of management, everyone must register for identity authentication."

"Whether to join the Great Xia Territory is entirely up to personal choice."

"If you are willing to join the Great Xia Territory, please swear to join when registering at the identity authentication registration office."

"If you are willing to join the Great Xia Territory and think you have a skill in a certain area, you can go to the Talent Recruitment Hall to recommend yourself."

"Those who pass the assessment of the Talent Recruitment Hall will become the direct subordinates of the Lord and participate in the management and construction of the territory."

As soon as the notice came out, it caused a great response among the refugees.

In particular, refugees are eligible to recommend themselves and become the direct subordinates of the Lord. This is a good opportunity for refugees to rise to the top in one step.

"Can you recommend all your skills?"

"This is a great opportunity, you can give it a try!"

"I'm still a little worried, will the assessment be too difficult?"

"We have nothing now! What else is there to worry about?"

"Then let's give it a try?"

"Let's go! Let's all give it a try!"

"..."

The courage of these refugees who have nothing is much stronger than that of the original residents of the city.

When people have lost everything and are left with only their lives, what else is there to be afraid of? !
